body: Exact bd50 falsifier: q=2^969; CostWeights.of(Max semantic, q entity, q granularity, rest zero) admits with fixed-order sum MaxValue, but actual Set order Granularity,Entity,Semantic makes present and eligible sums Infinity and scaleToEligible NaN. Baseline CostSuite 19/19; independent court fails 1/2 with ordered=1.7976931348623157E308, present=Infinity, eligible=Infinity, scaled=NaN. Runnable test is /tmp/storymodel4s-cost-audit.zE6XzO/align/src/test/scala/storymodel4s/align/CostOverflowAuditSuite.scala. Minimal patch: one CostTerm-enum-order subset-weight helper shared by scaleToEligible and supportOf so admission and consumption use the same nonnegative order; retain this regression. Chief has the same receipt. I can audit a corrected fresh successor immediately.
